description_sq:
Shitet apartament i organizuar ne dhome ndenje dhe kuzhine, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete, nje depo dhe ballkon qe lidh dhomen e ndenjes me ate matrimoniale. Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje nga pallatet me te mira ne zonen e Ish- Bllokut, ne zemer te Tiranes, perballe ish viles se Enverit. Arredimi i vecante me materialet me cilesore si dru lisi perdorur per dyert, dru arre per mobiljet, dru tik per parketin, kondicionere Daikin Multisplit Inverter, vendndodhja perfekte dhe komuniteti e bejne kete apartament te pershtatshem per nje jetese komode apo nje opsion ideal per investim. 
Per nje vizite ne prone, na kontaktoni!
description_en: Apartment for sale, organized in living room and kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a storage room and a balcony that connects the living room with the matrimonial one. The apartment is located in one of the best buildings in the area of ​​Ish-Blloku, in the heart of Tirana, in front of Enver's former villa. The special decoration with the highest quality materials such as oak wood used for the doors, walnut wood for the furniture, teak wood for the parquet, Daikin Multisplit Inverter air conditioners, the perfect location and the community make this apartment suitable for a comfortable life or an ideal investment option. For a visit to the property, contact us!
